entries.text: Answer the questions using the instructions in the original question paper below. 請按下方原題的字數限制及指示作答；錄音稿提供中英對照。 Questions 31–40 Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer. The Impact of Digital Technology on the Icelandic Language The Icelandic language ● has approximately 31 __________ speakers ● has a 32 __________ that is still growing ● has not changed a lot over the last thousand years ● has its own words for computer-based concepts, such as web browser and 33 __________ Young speakers ● are big users of digital technology, such as 34 __________ ● are becoming 35 __________ very quickly ● are having discussions using only English while they are in the 36 __________ at school ● are better able to identify the content of a 37 __________ in English than Icelandic Technology and internet companies ● write very little in Icelandic because of the small number of speakers and because of how complicated its 38 __________ is The Icelandic government ● has set up a fund to support the production of more digital content in the language ● believes that Icelandic has a secure future ● is worried that young Icelanders may lose their 39 __________ as Icelanders ● is worried about the consequences of children not being 40 __________ in either Icelandic or English ● has approximately 31 __________ speakers ● has a 32 __________ that is still growing 33 __________ ● are big users of digital technology, such as 34 __________ ● are becoming 35 __________ very quickly ● are having discussions using only English while they are in the 36 __________ at school ● are better able to identify the content of a 37 __________ in English because of how complicated its 38 __________ is ● is worried that young Icelanders may lose their 39 __________ as ● is worried about the consequences of children not being 40 __________ Right, everyone, let’s make a start. 好，各位，我們開始吧。 Over the past few sessions, we’ve been considering the reasons why some world languages are in decline, and today I’m going to introduce another factor that affects languages, and the speakers of those languages, and that’s technology and, in particular, digital technology. 過去幾節課中，我們一直在探討某些世界語言衰退的原因。 今天我要介紹另一個影響語言及其使用者的因素，那就是科技，尤其是數位科技。 In order to illustrate its effect, I’m going to focus on the Icelandic language, which is spoken by around 321,000 people, most of whom live in Iceland – an island in the North Atlantic Ocean. 為了說明它的影響，我會聚焦於冰島語。大約有 321,000 人使用冰島語，其中大多數人住在冰島，也就是北大西洋上的一個島國。 The problem for this language is not the number of speakers – even though this number is small. 對這種語言而言，問題不在於使用者數量，儘管這個數字確實很小。 Nor is it about losing words to other languages, such as English. 問題也不是詞彙被英語等其他語言取代。 In fact, the vocabulary of Icelandic is continually increasing because when speakers need a new word for something, they tend to create one, rather than borrowing from another language. 事實上，冰島語的詞彙量仍在不斷增加，因為當使用者需要新詞來表示某個事物時，他們傾向於創造新詞，而不是從其他語言借用。 All this makes Icelandic quite a special language – it’s changed very little in the past millennium, yet it can handle twenty-first-century concepts related to the use of computers and digital technology. 這一切使冰島語成為一種相當特殊的語言——過去一千年裡它變化很小，卻仍能處理與電腦和數位科技使用相關的 21 世紀概念。 Take, for example, the word for web browser … this is vafri in Icelandic, which comes from the verb “to wander”. 例如，web browser 在冰島語中是 vafri，來自表示「漫遊」 的動詞。 I can’t think of a more appropriate term because that’s exactly what you do mentally when you browse the internet. 我想不出更貼切的詞，因為當你瀏覽網路時，心理上正是在漫遊。 Then there’s an Icelandic word for podcast – which is too hard to pronounce! And so on. 另外，冰島語中也有 podcast 對應的詞，只是太難發音了！ 還有很多類似例子。 Icelandic, then, is alive and growing, but – and it’s a big but – young Icelanders spend a great deal of time in the digital world and this world is predominantly English. 因此，冰島語仍然有生命力， 也在成長；但是，這是一個很大的「但是」——年輕冰島人大量時間都花在數位世界，而這個世界主要由英語主導。 Think about smartphones. 想想智慧型手機。 They didn’t even exist until comparatively recently, but today young people use them all the time to read books, watch TV or films, play games, listen to music, and so on. 它們直到相對近年才出現，但如今年輕人一直用它們看書、 看電視或電影、玩遊戲、聽音樂等等。 Obviously, this is a good thing in many respects because it promotes their bilingual skills, but the extent of the influence of English in the virtual world is staggering and it’s all happening really fast. 顯然，這在許多方面是好事， 因為它促進了他們的雙語能力；但英語在虛擬世界中的影響程度令人震驚，而且一切都發生得非常快。 For their parents and grandparents, the change is less concerning because they already have their native-speaker skills in Icelandic. 對他們的父母和祖父母來說， 這種變化比較不令人擔心，因為他們已經具備冰島語母語者的能力。 But for young speakers – well, the outcome is a little troubling. 但對年輕使用者而言，結果就有些令人不安。 For example, teachers have found that playground conversations in Icelandic secondary schools can be conducted entirely in English. 例如，教師發現冰島中學操場上的對話可能完全用英語進行。 While teachers of much younger children have reported situations where their classes find it easier to say what is in a picture using English, rather than Icelandic. 而年紀更小孩子的老師也回報說，班上的孩子覺得用英語描述圖片內容比用冰島語更容易。 The very real and worrying consequence of all this is that the young generation in Iceland is at risk of losing its mother tongue. 這一切非常真實且令人擔憂的後果是，冰島年輕一代有失去母語的風險。 Of course, this is happening to other European languages too. 當然，這也發生在其他歐洲語言身上。 But while internet companies might be willing to offer, say, French options in their systems, it’s much harder for them to justify the expense of doing the same for a language that has a population the size of a French town, such as Nice. 但是，網路公司可能願意在系統中提供法語選項；然而，對於使用人口只相當於法國尼斯這樣一座城市規模的語言， 要證明投入同樣成本是合理的，就困難得多。 The other drawback of Icelandic is the grammar, which is significantly more complex than in most languages. 冰島語的另一個不利因素是它的語法，比大多數語言複雜得多。 At the moment, the tech giants are simply not interested in tackling this. 目前，科技巨頭根本沒有興趣處理這個問題。 So, what is the Icelandic government doing about this? 那麼，冰島政府對此做了什麼呢？ Well, large sums of money are being allocated to a language technology fund that it is hoped will lead to the development of Icelandic sourced apps and other social media and digital systems, but clearly this is going to be an uphill struggle. 大量資金已被分配到一個語言科技基金，希望能促成以冰島語為基礎的應用程式、社群媒體和其他數位系統的開發， 但很明顯，這將是一場艱難的努力。 On the positive side, they know that Icelandic is still the official language of education and government. 從正面來看，他們知道冰島語仍然是教育和政府的官方語言。 It has survived for well over a thousand years and the experts predict that its future in this nation state is sound and will continue to be so. 它已經存續了一千多年，專家預測它在這個民族國家中的未來仍然穩固，並會繼續如此。 However, there’s no doubt that it’s becoming an inevitable second choice in young people’s lives. 然而，毫無疑問，它正逐漸成為年輕人生活中不可避免的第二選擇。 This raises important questions. 這引發了重要問題。 When you consider how much of the past is tied up in a language, will young Icelanders lose their sense of their own identity? 當你考慮到一種語言承載了多少過去時，年輕冰島人會不會失去自己的身份認同感？ Another issue that concerns the government of Iceland is this. 冰島政府關心的另一個問題是這個。 If children are learning two languages through different routes, neither of which they are fully fluent in, will they be able to express themselves properly? 如果孩子們透過不同途徑學習兩種語言，但兩種都無法完全流利使用，他們還能正確表達自己嗎？

entries.title: Listening Practice 14
entries.text: Answer the questions using the instructions in the original question paper below. 請按下方原題的字數限制及指示作答；錄音稿提供中英對照。 Questions 1–10 Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer. Advice on Surfing Holidays Jack’s advice ● Recommends surfing for 1 __________ holidays in the summer ● Need to be quite 2 __________ Irish surfing locations County Clare ● Lahinch has some good quality 3 __________ and surf schools ● There are famous cliffs nearby County Mayo ● Good surf school at 4 __________ beach ● Surf camp lasts for one 5 __________ ● Can also explore the local 6 __________ by kayak Weather ● Best month to go: 7 __________ ● Average temperature in summer: approx. 8 __________ degrees Costs Equipment ● Wetsuit and surfboard: 9 __________ euros per day ● Also advisable to hire 10 __________ for warmth ● Recommends surfing for 1 __________ holidays in the summer ● Need to be quite 2 __________ ● Lahinch has some good quality 3 __________ and surf schools ● Good surf school at 4 __________ beach ● Surf camp lasts for one 5 __________ ● Can also explore the local 6 __________ by kayak ● Best month to go: 7 __________ ● Average temperature in summer: approx. 8 __________ degrees ● Wetsuit and surfboard: 9 __________ euros per day ● Also advisable to hire 10 __________ for warmth WOMAN: Jack, I’m thinking of taking the kids to the seaside on a surfing holiday this summer and I wanted to ask your advice – as I know you’re such an expert. 女士：Jack，我在想今年夏天帶孩子們去海邊度假學衝浪，所以想問問你的建議——因為我知道你很懂這方面。 JACK: Well, I don’t know about that, but yes, I’ve done a bit of surfing over the years. Jack：嗯，專家倒不敢說，但這些年我的確有衝過一些浪。 I’d thoroughly recommend it. 我非常推薦。 I think it’s the kind of holiday all the family can enjoy together. 我覺得這是一種全家人都能一起享受的假期。 The thing about surfing is that it’s great for all ages and all abilities. 衝浪的好處是，它適合各個年齡和不同能力的人。 My youngest started when he was only three! 我最小的孩子三歲就開始了！ WOMAN: Wow! But it’s quite physically demanding, isn’t it? 女士：哇！不過它對體力要求挺高的，對吧？ I’ve heard you need to be pretty fit. 我聽說需要身體相當健壯。 JACK: Yes. You’ll certainly learn more quickly and won’t tire as easily. Jack：是的。這樣肯定會學得更快，也不會那麼容易累。 WOMAN: Well – that should be OK for us. 女士：嗯，那我們應該沒問題。 You’ve been surfing a few times in Ireland, haven’t you? 你在愛爾蘭衝浪過幾次，對吧？ JACK: Yes. There’s some great surfing there, which people don’t always realise. Jack：是的。那裡有很棒的衝浪地點，只是人們不一定知道。 WOMAN: And which locations would you recommend? – there seem to be quite a few. 女士：那你會推薦哪些地方？看起來選擇不少。 JACK: Yes, there are loads. Jack：是的，很多。 Last year we went to County Donegal. 去年我們去了 County Donegal。 There are several great places to surf there. 那裡有幾個很棒的衝浪地點。 WOMAN: What about in County Clare? 女士：County Clare 呢？ I read that’s also really good for surfing. 我看到那裡也很適合衝浪。 JACK: Yes, it is. I’ve been there a few times. Jack：是的，確實。我去過幾次。 Most people go to Lahinch. 大多數人會去 Lahinch。 My kids love it there. 我的孩子們很喜歡那裡。 The waves aren’t too challenging and the town is very lively. 那裡的浪不會太難，而且小鎮很熱鬧。 WOMAN: Are there good hotels there? 女士：那裡有不錯的飯店嗎？ JACK: Yes – some very nice ones and there are also a few basic hostels and campsites. Jack：有，有些飯店很不錯，也有一些簡單的旅舍和露營地。 It’s great if you need lessons as the surf schools are excellent. 如果你需要上課，那裡也很適合，因為衝浪學校非常好。 WOMAN: Sounds good. 女士：聽起來不錯。 JACK: Yes and there’s lots to see in the area – like those well-known cliffs – … I’ve forgotten the name of them … Jack：是啊，而且那一帶有很多景點，比如那些著名的懸崖……我忘了名字了…… WOMAN: Oh don’t worry – I can look them up. 女士：哦，沒關係，我可以查一下。 JACK: I’ve also been surfing in County Mayo, which is less well-known for surfing, but we had a really good time. Jack：我也在 County Mayo 衝過浪，那裡比較不以衝浪聞名，但我們玩得很開心。 That was a few years ago when the kids were younger. 那是幾年前，孩子們還比較小的時候。 There’s a good surf school at Carrowniskey beach. Carrowniskey beach 有一所很好的衝浪學校。 WOMAN: How do you spell that? 女士：那怎麼拼？ JACK: C-A-double R-O-W-N-I-S-K-E-Y. Jack：C-A，兩個 R， O-W-N-I-S-K-E-Y。 WOMAN: OK. 女士：好的。 JACK: I put the kids into the surf camp they run during the summer for 10–16 year olds. Jack：我讓孩子們參加了他們夏天為 10 到 16 歲孩子辦的衝浪營。 WOMAN: Oh right. How long was that for? 女士：哦，這樣。那持續多久？ JACK: Three hours every day for a week. Jack：每天三小時，為期一週。 It was perfect – they were so tired out after that. 很完美——他們之後都累壞了。 WOMAN: I can imagine. 女士：我能想像。 JACK: One thing we did while the kids were surfing was to rent some kayaks to have a look around the bay which is nearby. Jack：孩子們衝浪時，我們做了一件事，就是租了幾艘皮艇，去附近的海灣看看。 It’s really beautiful. 那裡真的很美。 WOMAN: Oh, I’d love to do that. 女士：哦，我很想那樣做。 Now the only time I went to Ireland it rained practically every day. 我唯一一次去愛爾蘭時，幾乎天天下雨。 JACK: Mmm yes – that can be a problem – but you can surf in the rain, you know. Jack：嗯，是的，那可能是個問題。不過你知道，下雨也可以衝浪。 WOMAN: It doesn’t have the same appeal, somehow. 女士：不知怎麼的，那樣就沒那麼吸引人了。 JACK: Well, the weather’s been fine the last couple of years when I’ve been there, but actually, it tends to rain more in August than in the spring or autumn. Jack：嗯，過去幾年我去的時候天氣都不錯。不過實際上，八月通常比春天或秋天更容易下雨。 September’s my favourite month because the water is warmer then. 我最喜歡九月，因為那時水比較暖。 WOMAN: The only problem is that the kids are back to school then. 女士：唯一的問題是孩子們那時已經回學校了。 JACK: I know. But one good thing about Irish summers is that it doesn’t get too hot. Jack：我知道。不過愛爾蘭夏天有個好處，就是不會太熱。 The average temperature is about 19 degrees and it usually doesn’t go above 25 degrees. 平均溫度大約是 19 度，通常不會超過 25 度。 WOMAN: That sounds alright. Now what about costs? 女士：聽起來還可以。那費用呢？ JACK: Surfing is a pretty cheap holiday really – the only cost is the hire of equipment. Jack：衝浪其實是相當便宜的假期，唯一的費用就是租裝備。 You can expect to pay a daily rate of about 30 euros for the hire of a wetsuit and board – but you can save about 40 euros if you hire by the week. 租潛水衣和衝浪板每天大約 30 歐元，不過如果按週租，大約可以省 40 歐元。 WOMAN: That’s not too bad. 女士：那還不錯。 JACK: No. It’s important to make sure you get good quality wetsuits – you’ll all get too cold if you don’t. Jack：是啊。重要的是一定要租品質好的潛水衣，否則你們都會太冷。 And make sure you also get boots. 也一定要租靴子。 They keep your feet warm and it’s easier to surf with them on too. 它們能讓腳保持溫暖，而且穿著它們衝浪也比較容易。 WOMAN: OK. Well, thanks very much … 女士：好的。非常謝謝你……

entries.title: Listening Practice 14
entries.text: Answer the questions using the instructions in the original question paper below. 請按下方原題的字數限制及指示作答；錄音稿提供中英對照。 Questions 11 and 12 Choose TWO letters, A–E. Which TWO facts are given about the school’s extended hours childcare service? A. It started recently. B. More children attend after school than before school. C. An average of 50 children attend in the mornings. D. A child cannot attend both the before and after school sessions. E. The maximum number of children who can attend is 70. Questions 13–15 Choose the correct letter, A, B or C. 13. How much does childcare cost for a complete afternoon session per child? A. £3.50 B. £5.70 C. £7.20 14. What does the manager say about food? A. Children with allergies should bring their own food. B. Children may bring healthy snacks with them. C. Children are given a proper meal at 5 p.m. 15. What is different about arrangements in the school holidays? A. Children from other schools can attend. B. Older children can attend. C. A greater number of children can attend. Questions 16–20 What information is given about each of the following activities on offer? Choose FIVE answers from the box and write the correct letter, A–G, next to Questions 16–20. Information A. has limited availability B. is no longer available C. is for over 8s only D. requires help from parents E. involves an additional fee F. is a new activity G. was requested by children Activities 16. Spanish __________ 17. Music __________ 18. Painting __________ 19. Yoga __________ 20. Cooking __________ Choose TWO letters, A–E. Which TWO facts are given about the school’s extended hours childcare service? It started recently. More children attend after school than before school. An average of 50 children attend in the mornings. A child cannot attend both the before and after school sessions. The maximum number of children who can attend is 70. How much does childcare cost for a complete afternoon session per child? £3.50 £5.70 £7.20 What does the manager say about food? Children with allergies should bring their own food. Children may bring healthy snacks with them. Children are given a proper meal at 5 p.m. What is different about arrangements in the school holidays? Children from other schools can attend. Older children can attend. A greater number of children can attend. Spanish has limited availability is no longer available is for over 8s only requires help from parents involves an additional fee is a new activity was requested by children Music has limited availability is no longer available is for over 8s only requires help from parents involves an additional fee is a new activity was requested by children Painting has limited availability is no longer available is for over 8s only requires help from parents involves an additional fee is a new activity was requested by children Yoga has limited availability is no longer available is for over 8s only requires help from parents involves an additional fee is a new activity was requested by children Cooking has limited availability is no longer available is for over 8s only requires help from parents involves an additional fee is a new activity was requested by children Good afternoon. My name’s Mrs Carter and I run the before and after school extended hours childcare service. 下午好。我是 Carter 太太，負責上學前和放學後的延時托育服務。 I hope you’ve had a chance to have a good look around the school and talk to staff and pupils. 希望你們已經有機會好好參觀學校，並和教職員及學生聊過。 I know that many of you are interested in using our childcare service when your child joins the school, and perhaps you already know something about it, but for those that don’t, I’ll go through the main details now. 我知道很多人在孩子入學後會對我們的托育服務感興趣，也許你們已經了解一些情況；如果還不了解，我現在會介紹主要細節。 We offer childcare for children from the ages of four to eleven both before and after school. 我們為 4 歲到 11 歲的孩子提供上學前和放學後托育服務。 I know that many parents who work find this service invaluable. 我知道很多工作的父母都覺得這項服務非常有價值。 You can leave your child with us safe in the knowledge that they will be extremely well cared for. 你可以放心把孩子交給我們， 因為他們會受到非常好的照顧。 We are insured to provide care for up to 70 children, although we rarely have this many attending at any one session. 我們的保險允許我們最多照顧 70 名兒童，雖然任何一個時段通常都不會有這麼多人。 I think we generally expect around 50–60 children for the afternoon sessions and about half that number for the breakfast sessions. 一般來說，下午時段大約有 50 到 60 名兒童，早餐時段大約是這個數字的一半。 Although we currently do have 70 children registered with us, not all of these attend every day. 雖然目前有 70 名兒童在我們這裡註冊，但並不是每天都全部參加。 It’s ten years since we began offering an extended hours service and we’ve come a long way during that time. 我們開始提供延時托育服務已經十年了，這段時間我們發展了很多。 When we first opened, we only had about 20 children attending regularly. 剛開始時，只有大約 20 名孩子固定參加。 We try to keep our costs as low as we can and we think we provide very good value for money. 我們盡量把費用維持在較低水平，也認為我們的服務物有所值。 For the afternoon sessions, which run from 3.30 until 6 p.m., it’s £7.20. 下午時段從 3:30 到 6:00，費用是 7.20 英鎊。 But if you prefer, you can pay for one hour only, which costs £3.50, or two hours which costs £5.70. 不過如果你願意，也可以只付一小時費用，為 3.50 英鎊，或兩小時，為 5.70 英鎊。 The cost of the childcare includes food and snacks. 托育費用包括食物和點心。 They’ll be given breakfast in the morning and in the afternoon, a healthy snack as soon as they finish school. 早上會提供早餐，下午孩子們一放學就會有健康點心。 At 5 p.m. children are given something more substantial, such as pasta or a casserole. 下午 5 點，孩子們會吃到更有份量的食物，例如義大利麵或燉菜。 Please inform us of any allergies that your child might have and we’ll make sure they’re offered a suitable alternative. 請告知我們孩子是否有任何過敏，我們會確保提供合適的替代食物。 As you may know, the childcare service runs through the school holidays from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. 如你們可能知道的，學校假期期間也有托育服務，時間是早上 8 點到下午 6 點。 We offer a really varied and exciting programme to keep the children entertained – we don’t want them to feel as if they are still at school! 我們提供非常多樣且有趣的活動，讓孩子們開心參與——我們不希望他們覺得自己還在上學！ It will also feel different because they’ll get the chance to make new friends with children from other schools. 這也會讓他們覺得不同，因為他們有機會和其他學校的孩子交朋友。 Spaces are available for them because a lot of our term-time children don’t always attend during the holiday. 因為很多平時上課期間參加托育的孩子假期不一定會來，所以有空位給其他學校的孩子。 In the past, parents have asked if children over the age of 11 are allowed to come with their younger brothers and sisters. 過去有家長問過，11 歲以上的孩子是否可以和弟弟妹妹一起來。 But I’m afraid we’re unable to do this because of the type of insurance we have. 但很抱歉，因為我們的保險類型不允許這樣做。 So now let me tell you about some of the activities that your child can do during the afterschool sessions. 現在讓我介紹一些孩子在課後時段可以參加的活動。 As well as being able to use the playground equipment, computers and the library, there is usually at least one “special” activity that children can do each day. 除了可以使用遊樂場設備、電腦和圖書館外，孩子們每天通常至少可以參加一項「特別」活動。 For example, Spanish. 例如西班牙語。 We have a specialist teacher coming in every Thursday to give a basic introduction to the language through games and songs. 每週四會有一位專業老師來， 透過遊戲和歌曲教孩子們西班牙語入門。 She does two sessions: one for the over 8s and one for the younger children. 她會開兩個班：一個給 8 歲以上孩子，另一個給年紀較小的孩子。 This is the only activity which we have to make an extra charge for – but it’s well worth it. 這是唯一需要額外收費的活動，但非常值得。 Once a week the children have the opportunity to do some music. 孩子們每週有一次參加音樂活動的機會。 We’re very lucky that one of our staff is a member of a folk band. 我們很幸運，有一位工作人員是民謠樂團成員。 On Mondays, she teaches singing and percussion to groups of children. 每週一，她會教孩子們唱歌和打擊樂。 We do rely on parental support for this, so if any of you sing or play an instrument and would be prepared to help out at these sessions, we’d be delighted. 這項活動確實需要家長支援， 所以如果你們當中有人會唱歌或演奏樂器，也願意協助這些課程，我們會非常高興。 Painting continues to be one of the most popular activities. 繪畫仍然是最受歡迎的活動之一。 To begin with we weren’t keen on offering this because of the extra mess involved, but children kept asking if they could do some art and so we finally gave in. 一開始我們不太願意提供這項活動，因為會弄得比較亂，但孩子們一直要求做美術，所以我們最後讓步了。 Art is great for helping the children to relax after working hard at school all day. 藝術很適合幫助孩子在學校努力學習一整天後放鬆。 Yoga is something that we’ve been meaning to introduce for some time but haven’t been able to find anyone available to teach it – until now that is. 瑜伽是我們一直想引進的活動，但之前一直找不到能教的人，直到現在才找到。 So we’ll see how this goes. 所以我們會看看效果如何。 Hopefully, children will benefit in all sorts of ways from this. 希望孩子們能從中獲得各方面的益處。 Cooking is another popular activity. 烹飪也是另一項受歡迎的活動。 They make a different sort of cake, or pizza or bread each week. 他們每週會做不同種類的蛋糕、披薩或麵包。 Although the younger children love doing it, we found that the mess was just too much, so we’ve decided to restrict this to the over 8s, as they are better able to clean up after themselves. 雖然年紀較小的孩子很喜歡， 但我們發現場面實在太亂，所以決定只限 8 歲以上孩子參加，因為他們比較能自己收拾。

entries.title: Listening Practice 14
entries.text: Answer the questions using the instructions in the original question paper below. 請按下方原題的字數限制及指示作答；錄音稿提供中英對照。 Questions 21–24 Choose the correct letter, A, B or C. Holly’s Work Placement Tutorial 21. Holly has chosen the Orion Stadium placement because A. it involves children. B. it is outdoors. C. it sounds like fun. 22. Which aspect of safety does Dr Green emphasise most? A. ensuring children stay in the stadium B. checking the equipment children will use C. removing obstacles in changing rooms 23. What does Dr Green say about the spectators? A. They can be hard to manage. B. They make useful volunteers. C. They shouldn’t take photographs. 24. What has affected the schedule in the past? A. bad weather B. an injury C. extra time Questions 25–30 What do Holly and her tutor agree is an important aspect of each of the following events management skills? Choose SIX answers from the box and write the correct letter, A–H, next to Questions 25–30. Important aspects A. being flexible B. focusing on details C. having a smart appearance D. hiding your emotions E. relying on experts F. trusting your own views G. doing one thing at a time H. thinking of the future Events management skills 25. Communication __________ 26. Organisation __________ 27. Time management __________ 28. Creativity __________ 29. Leadership __________ 30. Networking __________ Holly has chosen the Orion Stadium placement because it involves children. it is outdoors. it sounds like fun. Which aspect of safety does Dr Green emphasise most? ensuring children stay in the stadium checking the equipment children will use removing obstacles in changing rooms What does Dr Green say about the spectators? They can be hard to manage. They make useful volunteers. They shouldn’t take photographs. What has affected the schedule in the past? bad weather an injury extra time Communication being flexible focusing on details having a smart appearance hiding your emotions relying on experts trusting your own views doing one thing at a time thinking of the future Organisation being flexible focusing on details having a smart appearance hiding your emotions relying on experts trusting your own views doing one thing at a time thinking of the future Time management being flexible focusing on details having a smart appearance hiding your emotions relying on experts trusting your own views doing one thing at a time thinking of the future Creativity being flexible focusing on details having a smart appearance hiding your emotions relying on experts trusting your own views doing one thing at a time thinking of the future Leadership being flexible focusing on details having a smart appearance hiding your emotions relying on experts trusting your own views doing one thing at a time thinking of the future Networking being flexible focusing on details having a smart appearance hiding your emotions relying on experts trusting your own views doing one thing at a time thinking of the future HOLLY: Hello Dr Green – I’m here to talk to you about my work placement. Holly：您好，Green 博士。我是來跟您談我的工作實習的。 TUTOR: Oh yes, it’s Holly, isn’t it? 導師：哦，是的，你是 Holly，對吧？ HOLLY: Yes. Holly：是的。 TUTOR: So, which work placement have you chosen? 導師：那你選擇了哪個實習項目？ HOLLY: I decided to go for the Orion Stadium placement. Holly：我決定選 Orion Stadium 的實習。 The event I’ll be managing is one where I’m helping to set up a sports competition for primary school children. 我要負責的活動是協助舉辦一場小學生體育比賽。 TUTOR: Yup. That’s always a popular placement – even though it can be tougher than you think working with children. 導師：是的。那一直是很受歡迎的實習項目，雖然和孩子一起工作可能比你想像中更困難。 HOLLY: I know, but it’s the fresh air that attracts me – organising something indoors doesn’t have the same appeal, even though it might be fun. Holly：我知道，但吸引我的是戶外的新鮮空氣——雖然室內活動可能也有趣，但對我來說吸引力不同。 TUTOR: OK, so obviously safety’s going to be one of your key concerns for this event. 導師：好的，那很明顯，安全會是這次活動的重點之一。 HOLLY: Yes, I’ve already thought about that. Holly：是的，我已經想過了。 I’ll need to make sure none of the equipment’s damaged. 我需要確保所有設備都沒有損壞。 TUTOR: Ah well, you’ll be working with schools, so the equipment will be their responsibility. 導師：嗯，你會和學校合作，所以設備會是他們的責任。 However, the grounds and what goes on there will be yours. 不過，場地和場地內發生的事情會由你負責。 HOLLY: Oh I see – that’ll include keeping everyone within the boundary once they’re in their kit and on the field? Holly：哦，我明白了——那包括孩子們換好裝備上場後，要確保他們都待在界線內？ TUTOR: Exactly – you’ll need to inspect areas like changing rooms as well for anything someone can trip over, but your main priority will be not to lose anyone! 導師：沒錯。你也需要檢查更衣室等地方，看是否有會讓人絆倒的東西，但你的首要任務是不讓任何人走失！ HOLLY: Right. I’ll need staff to help with that. Holly：明白。我需要工作人員幫忙。 TUTOR: And don’t forget about the spectators. 導師：也別忘了觀眾。 HOLLY: Mmm. I was thinking that many of them will be parents, who could help run the event. Holly：嗯。我本來想，很多觀眾會是家長，也許可以幫忙運作活動。 TUTOR: I wouldn’t rely on that. 導師：我不會依賴這一點。 They’ll be more interested in filming their children than volunteering. 他們會更想拍攝自己的孩子， 而不是當志工。 HOLLY: I’ll need to make sure they don’t interfere with events doing that! Holly：那我得確保他們拍攝時不會干擾活動！ TUTOR: And that’s not always easy, especially when a proud parent’s trying to get a snap of their child and you want them to move elsewhere. 導師：那並不總是容易，尤其是當一位自豪的家長想拍自己的孩子，而你又希望他們移到別處時。 HOLLY: OK. What about the scheduling? Holly：好的。那時間安排呢？ TUTOR: With sporting events there are all sorts of things that can alter the timetable – like rain, for instance – though so far, we’ve always been lucky with that. 導師：體育活動中有各種事情可能改變時間表，比如下雨，不過到目前為止我們在這方面一直很幸運。 HOLLY: Yeah, and I was thinking about what to do if someone got hurt as well. Holly：是啊，我也在想如果有人受傷該怎麼辦。 I know that last year that caused a terrible delay. 我知道去年就是因為有人受傷而造成嚴重延誤。 TUTOR: You have to be prepared for such things. 導師：你必須為這類事情做好準備。 HOLLY: Oh. What if a match ends in a draw – do you let the teams keep going until someone wins? Holly：哦。如果一場比賽平手呢？會讓隊伍繼續比，直到有人贏嗎？ TUTOR: That’ll be up to you – and again, you need to plan for it. 導師：那由你決定，而且同樣需要事先計畫。 HOLLY: Right. Holly：好的。 TUTOR: Now, the aim of your work placement is to give you the opportunity to develop the skills that an events manager needs. 導師：現在，你這次實習的目的，是讓你有機會培養活動管理者需要的技能。 So, let’s talk about those a bit. 所以我們來談談這些技能。 HOLLY: Well, I think my communication skills are pretty good. Holly：嗯，我覺得我的溝通能力相當不錯。 I can talk on the phone to people and book venues and that kind of thing. 我可以打電話和人溝通、預訂場地之類的。 TUTOR: Good – just remember it isn’t only about what you say. 導師：很好。但記住，溝通不只是你說了什麼。 If you meet someone face-to-face and want to persuade them to be a sponsor, for example … 例如，如果你和某人面對面見面，想說服他們成為贊助商 …… HOLLY: Oh, I’ll dress up for that! Sure. Holly：哦，那我會穿得正式得體！當然。 TUTOR: Good. Let’s go on to think about your organisational skills. 導師：很好。我們接著談你的組織能力。 You’re working in a very people-based industry and that means things won’t always go to plan. 你是在一個以人為主的行業工作，這意味著事情不會總是按計畫進行。 HOLLY: I guess it’s being prepared to make changes that matters. Holly：我想重要的是要準備好隨時做出改變。 TUTOR: That’s right. You may have to make an on-the-spot change to a timetable because of a problem you hadn’t anticipated … 導師：沒錯。你可能因為未預料到的問題，必須當場調整時間表…… HOLLY: … just do it! OK. Holly：……那就直接改！明白。 TUTOR: How’s your time management these days? 導師：你最近的時間管理怎麼樣？ HOLLY: I’m working on it – I’m certainly better when I have a deadline, which is why this work suits me. Holly：我正在努力改善。有截止期限時我肯定表現更好，這也是為什麼這份工作適合我。 TUTOR: Yes, but it’s how you respond as that deadline approaches! 導師：是的，但關鍵是截止期限接近時你如何反應！ HOLLY: I know I’ve got to look calm even if I’m in a panic. Holly：我知道即使心裡很慌，也得看起來冷靜。 TUTOR: Just think to yourself – no one must know I’m under pressure. 導師：就告訴自己——不能讓任何人知道我有壓力。 HOLLY: Yeah – even though I’m multi-tasking like crazy! Holly：是啊，即使我正在瘋狂地同時處理很多事情！ TUTOR: Another skill that events managers need is creativity. 導師：活動管理者需要的另一項技能是創造力。 Often your client has what we call the “big picture” idea, but it’s up to the events manager to think of all the fine points that go to making it work. 通常客戶會有我們所說的「大方向」想法，但活動管理者要負責思考所有讓它能實際運作的細節。 HOLLY: Right, so I need to listen carefully to that idea and then fill in all the gaps. Holly：對，所以我需要仔細聽那個想法，然後補上所有細節。 TUTOR: That’s right. And you’ll have a team working under you, so another key skill is leadership. 導師：沒錯。你手下會有一個團隊，所以另一項關鍵技能是領導力。 Your team may have lots of ideas too, but you’ve got to make the ultimate choices. 你的團隊可能也有很多想法， 但你必須做最終決定。 Do we have refreshments inside or out, for example? 例如，我們是在室內還是室外提供茶點？ HOLLY: Isn’t it better to be democratic? Holly：民主一點不是更好嗎？ TUTOR: It’s a nice idea, but you have the ultimate responsibility. 導師：這想法很好，但你負有最終責任。 So, believe in what you think best. 所以，要相信自己認為最好的判斷。 Be prepared to say “yes, that’s a good idea but it won’t work here”. 要準備好說：「是的，這是個好想法，但在這裡行不通。」 HOLLY: I see what you mean. Holly：我明白你的意思了。 What about the networking side of things? 那人脈建立方面呢？ I know it’s an area that a lot of students worry about because we don’t have much experience to offer others. 我知道這是很多學生擔心的領域，因為我們沒有太多經驗可以提供給別人。 TUTOR: But even without it – you can still be an interesting person with useful ideas. 導師：但即使沒有經驗，你仍然可以是一個有趣、又有實用想法的人。 And the more people you impress, the better. 你讓越多人留下好印象，就越好。 HOLLY: I guess that will help me when I apply for a real job. Holly：我想那會在我申請真正工作時有幫助。 TUTOR: Exactly – think ahead – remember what your ambitions are and keep them in mind. 導師：正是如此。要往前想，記住自己的抱負，並始終放在心上。 HOLLY: Definitely. Holly：一定會。

entries.title: Listening Practice 14
entries.text: Answer the questions using the instructions in the original question paper below. 請按下方原題的字數限制及指示作答；錄音稿提供中英對照。 Questions 31–40 Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer. Bird Migration Theory Most birds are believed to migrate seasonally. Hibernation theory ● It was believed that birds hibernated underwater or buried themselves in 31 __________. ● This theory was later disproved by experiments on caged birds. Transmutation theory ● Aristotle believed birds changed from one species into another in summer and winter. ○ In autumn he observed that redstarts experience the loss of 32 __________ and thought they then turned into robins. ○ Aristotle’s assumptions were logical because the two species of birds had a similar 33 __________. 17th century ● Charles Morton popularised the idea that birds fly to the 34 __________ in winter. Scientific developments ● In 1822, a stork was killed in Germany which had an African spear in its 35 __________. ○ previously there had been no 36 __________ that storks migrate to Africa ● Little was known about the 37 __________ and journeys of migrating birds until the practice of ringing was established. ○ It was thought large birds carried small birds on some journeys because they were considered incapable of travelling across huge 38 __________. ○ Ringing depended on what is called the 39 “__________” of dead birds. ● In 1931, the first 40 __________ to show the migration of European birds was printed. 31 __________. ○ In autumn he observed that redstarts experience the loss of 32 __________ and thought they then turned into robins. birds had a similar 33 __________. ● Charles Morton popularised the idea that birds fly to the 34 __________ 35 __________. ○ previously there had been no 36 __________ that storks migrate to ● Little was known about the 37 __________ and journeys of migrating 38 __________. Ringing depended on what is called the ‘_____’ of dead birds. ● In 1931, the first 40 __________ to show the migration of European birds Scientists believe that a majority of the earth’s bird population migrate in some fashion or other. 科學家認為，地球上大多數鳥類都會以某種方式遷徙。 Some travel seasonally for relatively short distances, such as birds that move from their winter habitats in lowlands to mountain tops for the summers. 有些鳥會進行相對短距離的季節性遷徙，例如從低地冬季棲地遷往山頂度夏的鳥類。 Others, like the Arctic Tern, travel more than 25,000 miles seasonally between the northern and southern poles. 其他鳥類，例如北極燕鷗，會在南北極之間進行超過 25,000 英里的季節性遷徙。 Bird migration has been studied over many centuries through a variety of observations. 幾個世紀以來，人們透過各種觀察研究鳥類遷徙。 But until relatively recently, where birds went to in the winter was considered something of a mystery. 但直到相對近代以前，鳥類冬天去了哪裡仍被視為一個謎。 The lack of modern science and technology led to many theories that we now recognize as error-filled and even somewhat amusing. 由於缺乏現代科學與技術，人們提出了許多如今看來充滿錯誤，甚至有些好笑的理論。 Take hibernation theory for example – two thousand years ago, it was commonly believed that when birds left an area, they went underwater to hibernate in the seas and oceans. 以冬眠理論為例，兩千年前， 人們普遍認為鳥類離開某地後，會潛入水下，在海洋中冬眠。 Another theory for the regular appearance and disappearance of birds was that they spent winter hidden in mud till the weather changed and food became abundant again. 另一種解釋鳥類定期出現與消失的理論認為，牠們冬天藏在泥裡，直到天氣轉變、食物再次充足才出現。 The theory that some birds hibernate persisted until experiments were done on caged birds in the 1940s which demonstrated that birds have no hibernation instinct. 某些鳥類會冬眠的理論一直延續到 1940 年代，當時對籠中鳥所做的實驗證明，鳥類並沒有冬眠本能。 One of the earliest naturalists and philosophers from ancient Greece was Aristotle who was the first writer to discuss the disappearance and reappearance of some bird species at certain times of year. 古希臘最早的自然學家和哲學家之一 Aristotle，是第一位書寫討論某些鳥類在一年中特定時間消失又出現的人。 He developed the theory of transmutation, the seasonal change of one species into another, by observing redstarts and robins. 他透過觀察紅尾鴝和知更鳥， 提出了物種轉變理論，也就是一種鳥會隨季節變成另一種鳥。 He observed that in the autumn, small birds called “redstarts” began to lose their feathers, which convinced Aristotle that they changed into robins for the winter, and back into redstarts in the summer. 他觀察到秋天時，一種叫 redstarts 的小鳥開始掉羽毛， 這讓 Aristotle 相信牠們冬天會變成 robins，夏天又變回 redstarts。 These assumptions are understandable given that this pair of species are similar in shape, but are a classic example of an incorrect interpretation based on correct observations. 鑑於這兩種鳥外形相似，這些假設可以理解，但它們是基於正確觀察卻做出錯誤解釋的典型例子。 The most bizarre theory was put forward by an English amateur scientist, Charles Morton, in the seventeenth century. 最古怪的理論是 17 世紀英國業餘科學家 Charles Morton 提出的。 He wrote a surprisingly well-regarded paper claiming that birds migrate to the moon and back every year. 他寫了一篇出人意料地頗受重視的論文，聲稱鳥類每年會遷徙到月球再返回。 He came to this conclusion as the only logical explanation for the total disappearance of some species. 他得出這個結論，是因為他認為這是某些物種完全消失的唯一合理解釋。 One of the key moments in the development of migration theory came in 1822 when a white stork was shot in Germany. 遷徙理論發展中的一個關鍵時刻出現在 1822 年，當時一隻白鸛在德國被射殺。 This particular stork made history because of the long spear in its neck which incredibly had not killed it – everyone immediately realised this spear was definitely not European. 這隻白鸛載入史冊，是因為牠脖子上插著一支長矛，令人難以置信的是牠並沒有因此死亡；大家立刻意識到這支矛絕不是歐洲的。 It turned out to be a spear from a tribe in Central Africa. 結果證明，那是一支來自中非某部落的長矛。 This was a truly defining moment in the history of ornithology because it was the first evidence that storks spend their winters in sub-Saharan Africa. 這是鳥類學史上真正具有決定意義的時刻，因為它是白鸛會在撒哈拉以南非洲過冬的第一個證據。 You can still see the “arrow stork” in the Zoological Collection of the University of Rostock in Germany. 如今你仍可在德國 Rostock University 的動物收藏中看到這隻「箭鸛」。 People gradually became aware that European birds moved south in autumn and north in summer but didn’t know much about it until the practice of catching birds and putting rings on their legs became established. 人們逐漸意識到歐洲鳥類秋天南飛、夏天北返，但直到捕捉鳥類並在牠們腿上套環的做法建立之前，人們對此了解並不多。 Before this, very little information was available about the actual destinations of particular species and how they travelled there. 在此之前，人們幾乎不知道特定物種實際前往的目的地，以及牠們如何抵達那裡。 People speculated that larger birds provided a kind of taxi service for smaller birds by carrying them on their backs. 人們猜測，大型鳥類會把小型鳥類背在背上，為牠們提供一種類似計程車的服務。 This idea came about because it seemed impossible that small birds weighing only a few grams could fly over vast oceans. 這個想法之所以產生，是因為人們覺得只有幾克重的小鳥不可能飛越廣闊海洋。 This idea was supported by observations of bird behavior such as the harassment of larger birds by smaller birds. 這種想法也被一些鳥類行為觀察所支持，例如小型鳥類騷擾大型鳥類。 The development of bird ringing, by a Danish schoolteacher, Hans Christian Cornelius Mortensen, made many discoveries possible. 丹麥教師 Hans Christian Cornelius Mortensen 發展出的鳥類繫放技術，使許多發現成為可能。 This is still common practice today and relies upon what is known as “recovery” – this is when ringed birds are found dead in the place they have migrated to, and identified. 這至今仍是常見做法，並依賴所謂的 “recovery”，也就是在鳥類遷徙到的地方發現死亡的繫放鳥，並加以識別。 Huge amounts of data were gathered in the early part of the twentieth century and for the first time in history people understood where birds actually went to in winter. 20 世紀初期，人們收集了大量資料，歷史上第一次真正了解鳥類冬天實際去了哪裡。 In 1931, an atlas was published showing where the most common species of European birds migrated to. 1931 年，一本地圖集出版，顯示歐洲最常見鳥類遷徙到哪些地方。 More recent theories about bird migration … 關於鳥類遷徙的較新理論……

entries.title: Listening Practice 15
entries.text: Answer the questions using the instructions in the original question paper below. 請按下方原題的字數限制及指示作答；錄音稿提供中英對照。 Questions 1–10 Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD for each answer. Easy Life Cleaning Services Basic cleaning package offered ● Cleaning all surfaces ● Cleaning the 1 __________ throughout the apartment ● Cleaning shower, sinks, toilet etc. Additional services agreed Every week ● Cleaning the 2 __________ ● Ironing clothes — 3 __________ only Every month ● Cleaning all the 4 __________ from the inside ● Washing down the 5 __________ Other possibilities ● They can organise a plumber or an 6 __________ if necessary. ● A special cleaning service is available for customers who are allergic to 7 __________. Information on the cleaners ● Before being hired, all cleaners have a background check carried out by the 8 __________. ● References are required. ● All cleaners are given 9 __________ for two weeks. ● Customers send a 10 __________ after each visit. ● Usually, each customer has one regular cleaner. ● Cleaning the 1 __________ throughout the apartment ● Cleaning the 2 __________ ● Ironing clothes — 3 __________ only ● Cleaning all the 4 __________ from the inside ● Washing down the 5 __________ ● They can organise a plumber or an 6 __________ if necessary. ● A special cleaning service is available for customers who are allergic to 7 __________. the 8 __________. ● All cleaners are given 9 __________ for two weeks. ● Customers send a 10 __________ after each visit. JACINTA: Hello, Easy Life Cleaning Services, Jacinta speaking. Jacinta：您好，這裡是 Easy Life Cleaning Services，我是 Jacinta 。 CLIENT: Oh hello. I’m looking for a cleaning service for my apartment – do you do domestic cleaning? Client：哦，你好。我想找清潔服務來打掃我的公寓，你們提供住家清潔嗎？ JACINTA: Sure. Jacinta：當然。 CLIENT: Well, it’s just a one-bedroom flat. Do you have a basic cleaning package? Client：嗯，只是一間一房公寓。 你們有基本清潔套餐嗎？ JACINTA: Yes. For a one-bedroom flat we’re probably looking at about two hours for a clean. Jacinta：有的。一房公寓的清潔大概需要兩個小時。 So we’d do a thorough clean of all surfaces in each room, and polish them where necessary. 我們會徹底清潔每個房間的所有表面，必要時也會拋光。 Does your apartment have carpets? 你的公寓有地毯嗎？ CLIENT: No, I don’t have any, but the floor would need cleaning. Client：沒有，一塊也沒有，不過地板需要清潔。 JACINTA: Of course – we’d do that in every room. Jacinta：當然，我們會清潔每個房間的地板。 And we’d do a thorough clean of the kitchen and bathroom. 我們也會徹底清潔廚房和浴室。 CLIENT: OK. Client：好的。 JACINTA: Then we have some additional services which you can request if you want – so for example, we can clean your oven for you every week. Jacinta：另外，我們還有一些額外服務，你可以視需要提出。例如，我們可以每週幫你清潔烤箱。 CLIENT: Actually, I hardly ever use that, but can you do the fridge? Client：其實我幾乎不用烤箱， 不過你們可以清潔冰箱嗎？ JACINTA: Sure. Would you like that done every week? Jacinta：當然。你希望每週清潔一次嗎？ CLIENT: Yes, definitely. And would ironing clothes be an additional service you can do? Client：是的，肯定要。那熨衣服也是你們能提供的額外服務嗎？ JACINTA: Yes, of course. Jacinta：是的，當然可以。 CLIENT: It wouldn’t be much, just my shirts for work that week. Client：不會很多，只要熨我那週上班穿的襯衫。 JACINTA: That’s fine. And we could also clean your microwave if you want. Jacinta：沒問題。如果你需要， 我們也可以清潔微波爐。 CLIENT: No, I wipe that out pretty regularly so there’s no need for that. Client：不用，我自己經常擦，所以不需要。 JACINTA: We also offer additional services that you might want a bit less often, say every month. Jacinta：我們也提供一些你可能不需要那麼頻繁做的額外服務，例如每月一次。 So for example, if the inside of your windows need cleaning, we could do that. 例如，如果窗戶內側需要清潔， 我們可以做。 CLIENT: Yes, that’d be good. Client：好的，那很好。 I’m on the fifteenth floor, so the outside gets done regularly by specialists, but the inside does get a bit grubby. 我住在十五樓，所以外側會定期由專業人員清潔，但內側確實會有點髒。 JACINTA: And we could arrange for your curtains to get cleaned if necessary. Jacinta：如果有需要，我們也可以安排清洗窗簾。 CLIENT: No, they’re OK. But would you be able to do something about the balcony? Client：不用，窗簾還好。不過你們能清潔一下陽台嗎？ It’s quite small and I don’t use it much, but it could do with a wash every month or so. 它很小，我也不常用，但大概每個月清洗一次會比較好。 JACINTA: Yes, we can get the pressure washer onto that. Jacinta：可以，我們可以用高壓清洗機處理。 JACINTA: Now if you’re interested, we do offer some other possibilities to do with general maintenance. Jacinta：如果你有興趣，我們也提供一些一般維修方面的協助。 For example, if you have a problem with water and you need a plumber in a hurry, we can put you in touch with a reliable one who can come out straightaway. 例如，如果你遇到水管問題，需要緊急找水管工，我們可以幫你聯絡可靠的人，能立刻上門。 And the same thing if you need an electrician. 如果你需要電工，也可以同樣幫你聯絡。 CLIENT: Right. That’s good to know. Client：好的。知道這點很好。 I’ve only just moved here so I don’t have any of those sorts of contacts. 我才剛搬來這裡，所以還沒有這類聯絡人。 JACINTA: And I don’t know if this is of interest to you, but we also offer a special vacuum cleaning system which can improve the indoor air quality of your home by capturing up to 99% of all the dust in the air. Jacinta：我不知道你是否會感興趣，但我們也提供一種特殊吸塵系統，可以捕捉空氣中高達 99% 的灰塵，改善家中的室內空氣品質。 So if you’re troubled by allergies, this can make a big difference. 所以如果你有過敏困擾，這會有很大幫助。 CLIENT: Right. In fact, I don’t have that sort of problem, but I’ll bear it in mind. Client：了解。其實我沒有這方面的問題，但我會記住。 Now can you tell me a bit about your cleaning staff? 現在你能跟我說說你們的清潔人員嗎？ JACINTA: Of course. So all our cleaners are very carefully selected. Jacinta：當然。我們所有清潔人員都經過非常謹慎的篩選。 When they apply to us, they have to undergo a security check with the police to make sure they don’t have any sort of criminal background, and, of course, they have to provide references as well. 他們申請時，必須接受警方安全背景調查，以確保沒有任何犯罪紀錄；當然，他們也必須提供推薦人資料。 Then if we think they might be suitable for the job, we give them training for it. 接著，如果我們認為他們可能適合這份工作，就會提供培訓。 That lasts for two weeks so it’s very thorough, and at the end of it, they have a test. 培訓持續兩週，所以非常完整； 結束時他們還要接受測驗。 If they pass that, we take them on, but we monitor them very carefully – we ask all our clients to complete a review of their performance after every visit and to email it to us. 如果他們通過，我們就會錄用， 但仍會非常仔細地監督；我們會請所有客戶在每次服務後填寫清潔人員表現評價，並用電子郵件寄給我們。 So we can pick up any problems straightaway and deal with them. 這樣我們就能立刻發現任何問題並處理。 CLIENT: OK, well that all sounds good. Client：好的，聽起來都不錯。 And will I always have the same cleaner? 那我會一直由同一位清潔人員服務嗎？ JACINTA: Yes, we do our best to organise it that way, and we usually manage it. Jacinta：是的，我們會盡力這樣安排，而且通常可以做到。 CLIENT: Good. That’s fine. Right, so I’d like to go ahead and … Client：很好，那就好。那麼，我想接著……

entries.title: Listening Practice 15
entries.text: Answer the questions using the instructions in the original question paper below. 請按下方原題的字數限制及指示作答；錄音稿提供中英對照。 Questions 11–14 Choose the correct letter, A, B or C. 11. Many hotel managers are unaware that their staff often leave because of A. a lack of training. B. long hours. C. low pay. 12. What is the impact of high staff turnover on managers? A. an increased workload B. low morale C. an inability to meet targets 13. What mistake should managers always avoid? A. failing to treat staff equally B. reorganising shifts without warning C. neglecting to have enough staff during busy periods 14. What unexpected benefit did Dunwich Hotel notice after improving staff retention rates? A. a fall in customer complaints B. an increase in loyalty club membership C. a rise in spending per customer Questions 15–20 Which way of reducing staff turnover was used in each of the following hotels? Write the correct letter, A, B or C, next to Questions 15–20. Ways of reducing staff turnover A. improving relationships and teamwork B. offering incentives and financial benefits C. providing career opportunities Hotels 15. The Sun Club __________ 16. The Portland __________ 17. Bluewater Hotels __________ 18. Pentlow Hotels __________ 19. Green Planet __________ 20. The Amesbury __________ Many hotel managers are unaware that their staff often leave because of a lack of training. long hours. low pay. What is the impact of high staff turnover on managers? an increased workload low morale an inability to meet targets What mistake should managers always avoid? failing to treat staff equally reorganising shifts without warning neglecting to have enough staff during busy periods What unexpected benefit did Dunwich Hotel notice after improving staff retention rates? a fall in customer complaints an increase in loyalty club membership a rise in spending per customer The Sun Club improving relationships and teamwork offering incentives and financial benefits providing career opportunities The Portland improving relationships and teamwork offering incentives and financial benefits providing career opportunities Bluewater Hotels improving relationships and teamwork offering incentives and financial benefits providing career opportunities Pentlow Hotels improving relationships and teamwork offering incentives and financial benefits providing career opportunities Green Planet improving relationships and teamwork offering incentives and financial benefits providing career opportunities The Amesbury improving relationships and teamwork offering incentives and financial benefits providing career opportunities As many of you here today have worked in the hotel industry for some time, I’m sure you have experienced the problem of high staff turnover in your hotels. 今天在座許多人已經在飯店業工作了一段時間，我相信你們都經歷過飯店員工流動率高的問題。 Every hotel relies on having loyal and experienced members of staff who make sure that everything runs smoothly. 每家飯店都仰賴忠誠且有經驗的員工，確保一切順利運作。 If staff are constantly changing, it can make life difficult for everyone. 如果員工一直更換，會讓所有人的工作都變得困難。 But why do staff leave frequently in many hotels? 但為什麼許多飯店的員工會頻繁離職呢？ Of course, many hotel jobs, such as cleaning, are low-skilled and are not well-paid. 當然，許多飯店工作，例如清潔，技能要求不高，薪資也不高。 A lot of managers think it’s this and the long hours that are the main causes of high staff turnover – but what they don’t realise is that it’s the lack of training in many hotel jobs which is a huge factor. 很多經理認為，低薪和工時長是員工高流動率的主要原因； 但他們沒有意識到，許多飯店工作缺乏培訓才是一個重大因素。 So, what kind of problems does a high turnover of staff cause? 那麼，高員工流動率會造成什麼問題呢？ Well, having to recruit new staff all the time can be very time-consuming, and managers may have to cover some duties while waiting for new staff to arrive. 一直招聘新員工非常耗時，而經理在等待新員工到職時，可能還得代為承擔一些工作。 This means they don’t have time to think about less immediate problems such as how to improve their service. 這意味著他們沒有時間思考那些不那麼緊急的問題，例如如何改善服務。 When staff leave, it can also severely affect the colleagues they leave behind. 員工離職時，也會嚴重影響留下來的同事。 It has a negative effect on remaining staff, who may start to feel that they too should be thinking about leaving. 這會對留下來的員工造成負面影響，他們可能也開始覺得自己應該考慮離職。 So, what can be done to change this situation? 那麼，可以做些什麼來改變這種情況呢？ Firstly, managers should stop making basic errors which leave their staff feeling upset and resentful. 首先，經理應停止犯一些會讓員工感到不滿和怨恨的基本錯誤。 When organising shifts, for example, make sure you never give certain staff preferential treatment. 例如，在安排班表時，一定不要給某些員工特別優待。 All staff should be given some choice about when they work, and everyone should have to work some evening and weekend shifts. 所有員工都應該對工作時間有一定選擇權，而每個人也都應分擔一些晚班和週末班。 If you treat staff fairly, they’ll be more likely to step in and help when extra staff are needed. 如果你公平對待員工，當需要額外人手時，他們更可能願意主動幫忙。 Keeping staff happy has other tangible benefits for the business. 讓員工保持滿意，對企業也有其他實際好處。 Take the Dunwich Hotel as an example. 以 Dunwich Hotel 為例。 It had been experiencing a problem with staff complaints and in order to deal with this, invested in staff training and improved staff conditions. 它曾面臨員工投訴問題，為了解決這點，飯店投資於員工培訓並改善工作條件。 Not only did the level of complaints fall, but they also noticed a significant increase in the amount each customer spent during their stay. 不僅投訴數量下降，他們還注意到每位顧客入住期間的消費金額明顯增加。 They have now introduced a customer loyalty scheme which is going really well. 他們現在推出了一項顧客忠誠計畫，進展非常順利。 Now I’d like to look at some ways you can reduce staff turnover in your hotels, and I’ll do this by giving some examples of hotels where I’ve done some training recently. 現在我想看看一些可以降低飯店員工流動率的方法，我會用最近我做過培訓的一些飯店作為例子。 The Sun Club received feedback which showed that staff thought managers didn’t value their opinions. The Sun Club 收到的回饋顯示，員工認為經理不重視他們的意見。 They weren’t made to feel they were partners who were contributing to the success of the business as a whole. 他們沒有感覺自己是為整個企業成功作出貢獻的夥伴。 This situation has changed. 這種情況現在已經改變。 Junior staff at all levels are regularly invited to meetings where their ideas are welcomed. 各層級的基層員工現在會定期受邀參加會議，而他們的想法也受到歡迎。 A year ago, The Portland recognised the need to invest in staff retention. 一年前，The Portland 意識到需要投資於員工留任。 Their first step was to introduce a scheme for recognising talent amongst their employees. 他們的第一步，是推出一項辨識員工中潛力人才的計畫。 The hope is that organising training for individuals with management potential will encourage them to stay with the business. 他們希望為具備管理潛力的人安排培訓，能鼓勵這些人留在企業中。 At Bluewater, managers decided to recognise 50 high achievers from across the company’s huge hotel chain. 在 Bluewater，經理們決定從公司龐大的飯店連鎖體系中表揚 50 名高績效員工。 As a reward, they’re sent on an all-expenses-paid trip abroad every year. 作為獎勵，他們每年會獲得一次全額支付費用的海外旅行。 Fun is an important element in the trips, but there’s also the opportunity to learn something useful. 旅行中的樂趣很重要，但同時也有機會學到有用的東西。 This year’s trip included a visit to a brewery, where staff learned about the new beer that would be served in the hotel. 今年的旅行包括參觀一家啤酒廠，員工在那裡了解飯店即將供應的新啤酒。 Pentlow Hotels identified that retention of junior reception staff was an issue. Pentlow Hotels 發現基層接待員的留任是一個問題。 In order to encourage them to see that working in a hotel could be worthwhile and rewarding, with good prospects, they introduced a management programme. 為了讓他們看到在飯店工作可以有價值、有回報且具備良好前景，飯店推出了一項管理計畫。 These staff were given additional responsibilities and the chance to work in various roles in the hotel. 這些員工被賦予額外責任，並有機會在飯店中擔任不同角色。 Green Planet wanted to be seen as a caring employer. Green Planet 希望被視為一個關心員工的雇主。 To make life easier for staff, many of whom had childcare responsibilities, the hotel began issuing vouchers to help cover the cost of childcare. 為了讓員工生活更輕鬆，其中許多人有育兒責任，飯店開始發放代金券，幫助支付托育費用。 Louise Marsh at The Amesbury has one of the best staff retention rates in the business. The Amesbury 的 Louise Marsh 擁有業界最佳員工留任率之一。 Since she joined the company, she has made a huge effort to achieve this by creating a co-operative and supportive environment. 自她加入公司以來，她透過建立合作且支持性的環境，為達成這一點付出了巨大努力。 For her, the staff are part of a large family where everyone is valued. 對她而言，員工是一個大家庭的一部分，每個人都受到重視。 OK, now I’d like to … 好的，現在我想……
